top_signals.title: Stocks Waver as Oil Rally Triggers Bond Volatility: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A renewed episode of bond volatility left traders unwilling to make riskier bets, with stocks wavering on worries that elevated oil prices will fuel inflation and force the Federal Reserve to lift rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Senate narrowly votes down resolution calling for end to Iran war
top_signals.summary: The vote came weeks before the midterm elections, where President Donald Trump's fellow Republicans are trying to retain their majorities in Congress.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
